column1: Cook the macaroni until just al dente or slightly underdone, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Melt the butter in a large skillet, stir in the flour, salt, pepper, and paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk and broth and cook over medium heat, whisking often, until thickened, 5–6 minutes.
Melt in 2 cups of the cheese, then stir in the pasta and adjust the seasoning.
Spread in a greased 9x13-inch dish and top with the remaining cheese and the panko.
Bake 10–15 minutes until bubbly, then broil 1–2 minutes to brown the top if you like.
